name: International GNSS Service (IGS)
reason: A scientific body; its satellite metadata file is maintained for it by the German Aerospace Center (DLR)

name: General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects (GCAT)
reason: One expert's catalogue, widely cited, with sources listed; not an institution, and its author says some dates are updated patchily

name: CelesTrak
graded_by: Proposed with issue 31 (awaiting the team's review)
reason: Republishes the US Space Force's public orbit records, the same data Space-Track holds; run by a non-profit and widely used by researchers. It says where an object is, not what its operator says about it
